name: 망각왕관 암흑기사

design: Female long ash-blonde hair, violet eyes, broken silver halo, black feather shoulder wings, violet-black articulated knight armor, tarnished gold trim, purple gemstone, violet crystal longsword. Fallen valkyrie. Short split armored skirt exposes separate greaved legs.

attack: casting a violet hex from staff

attack: casting teal void magic from staff

design: Male ash green hair, golden eyes, black antler circlet, blackened green leather armor and leaf cape, dark bronze edging, short split coat and visible two boots, curved thornwood bow glowing toxic emerald, small quiver on back.

design: Female auburn hair, amber eyes, black bandana and small dark captain hat, charcoal leather corsair coat with antique brass armor fittings, burnt orange scarf, visible two trouser legs and boots, heavy brass-and-obsidian hand cannon with ember core.

attack: casting violet sacred magic from cross staff

attack: casting crimson requiem spell from staff
